Class RmiVirtualView

java.lang.Object
network.server.rmi.RmiVirtualView
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualView
public class RmiVirtualView extends Object implements VirtualView
Server-side view of an RMI client. It forwards the server's messages to the client's exported ClientCallbackRemote and starts the liveness sentinel.

Every sendXxx is dispatched onto a dedicated single-thread executor per player, which issues the (synchronous, blocking) RMI callbacks one at a time and in order — so the client never receives overlapping callbacks. A failed callback (RemoteException) triggers the disconnect pipeline.

  • Field Details

    • SEND_INTERVAL_MS

      private static final long SEND_INTERVAL_MS
      Server-side RMI liveness intervals (milliseconds). Invariant: TIMEOUT_MS > 2 * SEND_INTERVAL_MS, to tolerate scheduling jitter and brief delays from large application messages occupying the sender. Worst-case detection time is TIMEOUT_MS + CHECK_INTERVAL_MS = 20 s.

    • closed

      private final AtomicBoolean closed
      Ensures the shutdown pipeline (sentinel + executor) runs at most once, even under a race between close() and handleDisconnect(). A CAS is used instead of synchronized so a callback thread never blocks on a monitor while completing the teardown.
